hero.mira.description: She knows every bell in the harbor by its sound.
card.csend.name: Deep Quiet
node.part.title: The shore
node.part.text: The lighthouse goes dark. Three short rings sound below. Your sister's boat drifts beside the pier.
choice.hang: Look for the source of the ringing
node.or.title: The keeper in the fog
node.or.text: The bell is ringing underwater. The fog wants a name in exchange for the boat. You give it yours, and the bell falls silent.
choice.haza: Use the rope to pull in the boat
node.torony.title: The cold lantern
node.torony.text: The lantern has run out of oil. Someone left the spare bottle on the outer ledge.
choice.olaj: Climb out into the wind to get it
choice.jel: Signal the boat with the tower bell
node.menedek.title: Back on shore
node.menedek.text: The bow scrapes against the pier. Your sister leaps ashore. Only once you are both in the light does she start to tell you what happened out there.
node.kod.title: The silent bell
node.kod.text: The sound of the bell sinks away. In the morning, all they find on the shore is your lantern.
